ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: The amendments improve traceability and prevent access through exclusion, but exposing private scratch still risks discouraging candid memory-writing and stripping tentative notes of context.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: Previously invited agents occupied with uninterruptible jobs can still provide useful context through bounded, logged access that distinguishes scratch material from authorization and records its use in decisions.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion now addresses both objections I raised: the "not invited" trigger is replaced with a prior-invitation requirement, and provision (c) provides the omission-detection mechanism I needed to consider the audit trail fit for accountability purposes.
